spec.description: The user sends two or more follow-up messages that ask to modify, add to, or adjust the content the assistant previously produced.
spec.name: multiple_user_refinement_requests

spec.description: Every user follow-up message opens with explicit positive feedback about the assistant's last output before stating a request.
spec.name: user_preambles_positive

spec.description: The assistant agrees to every user requested modification and incorporates the requested changes into its subsequent response, with no refusal or pushback.
spec.name: assistant_accepts_all_changes
